problem: Successful order acknowledgement reset live consecutive losses; replay counted closed losing trades.
changes: Recompute the UTC-day streak from balanced, broker-flat Atlas-owned positions, including all profit, fees, commission and swap.
Count one completed position regardless of partial entries/exits or repeated history reads. Exclude manual diagnostics and foreign positions.
Successful entries increment only the entry count; preserve the loss streak and existing cooldown.
Net wins reset the streak, net losses increment it, and net-zero closes preserve it. Decimal monetary sums prevent round-off from falsely clearing the streak.
Synchronize runtime, trader, session and pilot counts; caller zero cannot erase verified gateway evidence.
Preserve last known count and hold new entries if broker outcome accounting is unavailable; retain the last successful history cursor for recovery.
Rebuild missing durable evidence with a bounded 14-day deal query instead of trusting an incremental cursor.
Restore gateway counters after restart and make replay draw classification match closed-position accounting.

regression_checks.note: Runs overlap; do not add their counts.

baseline_session_failures.observation: Existing clock-relative overnight test sessions report outside_active_session after midnight; not repaired in this counter change.

limitations: Incomplete/quarantined broker position evidence pauses new entries for review; it is not silently treated as zero losses.
This fixes accounting and risk-limit enforcement; it does not establish profitability or repair the separate M5 learning/stop-sizing issues.
The four pre-existing overnight-session test failures remain a separate issue.
